versions.description_html:
Learn how Azure Dedicated Host works, providing physical server isolation, security, and maintenance control in the Microsoft cloud. Simply explained.

Why would you rent an entire physical server in Azure when you could just create a virtual machine and pay for that?

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Opening: Why Would You Rent the Whole Server?
  • The Problem Dedicated Host Solves
  • What Azure Dedicated Host Actually Is
  • How the Building Blocks Fit Together
  • Isolation, Security, and Maintenance Control
  • Pricing, Licenses, and the Capacity Trap
  • When Dedicated Host Fits, and When It Doesn't
  • Conclusion: Choose the Right Level of Control

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
